topic: Data update requirements for Finland sensors
summary_markdown: A discussion arose regarding the necessity of updating Mediaco + clearn channel data in Finland. Initially, this task was postponed due to a large volume of sensors (23 mentioned). It was confirmed that the update is required to ensure consistency across all locations. The participants noted that both the new firmware deployment and the necessary coordination/approval process with JCD are time-consuming processes.
decisions: The Mediaco + clearn channel data in Finland must be updated.
